(manifest row **311**, Round 11 / P35, sub-round 11B). Invoked
`live_verification=false` — committed views + export code + fixtures
only; **no publish act, no staging run, no production mutation, no
merge to main**. Requirement stamps: **SIG-TRANSP-006** (also — the

decision reference each `disregarded` robots row cites) · **the J4
S-1…S-14 rules** via P35.31's module · **P31.2/P31.4** (the
completion/capture rows the views join). **Base:**
`r11/P35.32-ingest-run-report` (PR #325 — tip `2c9b4336`, 5/5
head-bound green, run 39215165924) · **Gate:** GATE-P B-19 recorded
yes; not an OM-20 row, no live leg, no window.

## The problem

The run/capture/issue transparency the public surface renders needs a
publication boundary — today `ingest_run_report` is deliberately
restricted (P35.32 narrowed it off `sig_read_public`), captures carry
per-run fields the public never sees raw (request fingerprints,
sealed URIs, WORM locators), and nothing turns the recorded execution
history into the `sig.run-record/1`-shaped release rows. Without this
row the P36.46 run-log page, the P35.41 freshness verdict and the
P36.49 issues surface have no scrubbed, execution-keyed feed — and a
shared `ingest_run` carrying several executions would silently lend
its code identity and completion counts to executions that never ran
them (K10 C-13).

## What ships

- **`policy.freshness`** — the shared cadence + state machinery the
  export, the status lane and ACT-02 alerting share (one pure
  function, never three verdicts): `cadence_rule` renders the
  *declared rule* (`"monthly, day 6"`, `"weekly, Monday"`, …) — a
  release-bound fact, never a timestamp (K9 C-4); `freshness_state`
  returns the closed C-7 vocabulary (`on_time` / `late` / `overdue` /
  `last_run_failed` / `never_run` / `not_scheduled` / `one_time_load`
  / `not_applicable` / honest `None` when no interval is evidenced)
  plus the `run_record_missing` flag (published records, no execution
  record — a flag, never a fabricated run); `AUTO_ISSUE_CLASSES` +
  `valid_issue_class` hold the closed J3 §7.3 vocabulary including the
  `upstream_http_<code>` / `quarantine_<reason>` open patterns; the
  quarantine reason vocabulary mirrors `assertion_quarantine`'s CHECK
  verbatim.
- **`v_transparency_run`** (`ingest_run_report ⋈ ingest_run ⋈
  ingest_run_completion`) — one row per *execution*, explicit columns
  only. The engine-side C-13 guard: where a run serves more than one
  recorded execution (live + backfilled report, or a second
  completion), the run-owned values — `code_commit`, connector
  identity, `finished_at`/`completion_status`/`claims_*` — emit NULL;
  the report's own execution fields always pass through.
- **`v_transparency_capture`** (`ingest_run_capture ⋈ evidence_capture
  ⋈ evidence_blob ⋈ evidence_artifact`) — one row per capture mark:
  classification, storage tier, digest, bytes, http status, retained
  status. A `LATERAL … LIMIT 1` join binds each mark to at most one
  capture row (content digest → blob digest → fetched URI, in that
  order — a mark never fans out); a mark with no resolving capture row
  keeps NULL capture fields. Both views: `GRANT SELECT TO sig_export`
  only — no `sig_read_public`, no `SELECT *`, every never-exported
  name (`parameters`, `environment`, `detail`, `run_record_uri`,
  `request_fingerprint`, `payload`, …) absent.
- **`transparency/runs.jsonl` — `sig.run-record/1`** — execution-keyed:
  `execution_id` is the report's own id; `started_at` falls back to
  `finished_at − duration_seconds` with the basis labelled; shared-run
  fields render `not_recorded (shared run)`; rejected counts fold
  off-vocabulary reasons into `other_unclassifiable` (never raw, never
  fabricated); `error_class` outside the S-4 vocabulary maps to
  `unclassified_error`; **robots outcomes render host + outcome +
  count, `disregarded` rows adding `decision_ref: GL-GATE-08` — never
  per-request detail** (B-19, carried verbatim).
- **`transparency/captures.jsonl` — `sig.capture-record/1`** —
  classification + served tier (the recorded tier tightened by the
  lane derivation, never a silent `public` upgrade; a mark with no
  capture row takes the lane floor, labelled `derived`); **a
  sealed-tier capture emits `target: "sealed"` — no URL, no URI, no
  path-hash**; `changed_vs_prior` is the digest-diff signal
  (`first`/`changed`/`unchanged`/`not_comparable (no digest)`).
- **`transparency/issues.jsonl` — `sig.source-issue/1`** — the
  auto-detected J3 §7.3 classes, append-only instances keyed
  `(source_id, issue_class, opened_at)`: `opened_at` the first
  showing, `last_seen_at` the latest, `closed_at` the first later
  execution *not* showing the class (still-open = null), `count` the
  observations, `basis` the evidence channel (`run_record` /
  `capture_mark` / `freshness_state` / `scheduler_probe`). Off-
  vocabulary classes can never be emitted (`valid_issue_class` guards
  the fire). Curated issues stay P36.49's.
- **`transparency/freshness.jsonl` — `sig.source-freshness/1`** — per
  source: `cadence_rule` + `cadence_basis` (`ops/cadence.toml` /
  `not_declared` / `not_recorded (cadence doc unreadable)`),
  `cadence_state`, `scheduled`, `one_time_load`, `freshness_state` +
  `run_record_missing`, `evaluated_at` pinned to the release as-of
  (K9 C-4's two-clocks rule — a release artifact never carries a
  reader-current value and no record carries a `next_*` field), the
  two change columns — `last_upstream_change` (digest-derived, honest
  basis) and `last_sig_records_change` (`first_release`/`not_published`
  with the UX9-4/P36.68 basis named) — plus `volatility` (predicate-
  registry distribution over published claims, interim basis named)
  and `staleness` typed `not_evaluable` per C-5 (undated observations
  are never "0 stale"; PKG-10's dating rule owns the verdict).
- **Wiring** — `TRANSPARENCY_QUERIES` merge into `EXPORT_QUERIES`
  (explicit-column selects, `to_regclass`-guarded like every key —
  a missing view degrades to honest-empty artifacts); emission rides
  `build_spine_export` with the release as-of as the evaluation
  instant; artifacts land under `transparency/` on the SIG
  licence/metadata compartment through the existing manifest.

## Test evidence

- `tests/unit/test_policy_freshness.py` (22) — the cadence-rule truth
  table (word + cron shapes), `previous_cron_fire` never at-or-after
  `at`, the full C-7 precedence table (`not_scheduled`/`one_time_load`/
  `not_applicable` → `never_run` → `last_run_failed` → `overdue` →
  `late` → `on_time`), `run_record_missing` independent of state, the
  closed issue vocabulary refusing internal classes.
- `tests/exports/test_transparency.py` (28) — C-13 tokens on shared
  runs; `finished_at − duration` fallback; outcome derivation;
  off-vocabulary rejected folding; the robots disclosure shape
  (host+count+`GL-GATE-08`, no request fields); sealed tier emits no
  locator; `changed_vs_prior`; `zero_records`/`never_run`/
  `upstream_http_503`/`quarantine_bad_digest`/`robots_disallow`/
  `rate_limited`/`capture_not_retained` fire; issues close on the
  first clean later execution; freshness rows pin `evaluated_at`;
  no `next_*` field on any artifact; byte-stable re-emission;
  forbidden-field sweep (`parameters`/`detail`/`notes`/`payload`
  never appear); `TRANSPARENCY_QUERIES` explicit + registered.
- `tests/unit/test_transparency_view_columns.py` (8) — the deploy
  script's parsed outer SELECT lists equal the allow-lists exactly;
  the verify script selects the same columns; `TRANSPARENCY_QUERIES`
  select the allow-lists verbatim; no `SELECT *`; never-exported
  names occur only inside comments; grants name `sig_export` only.
- `tests/db/test_transparency_views.py` (6, real PG18+PostGIS via the
  sqitch deploy+verify harness) — `information_schema` columns equal
  the allow-lists; `sig_export` granted, `sig_read_public` not; the
  C-13 suppression fires for a two-execution run and the sole run
  keeps its values; populated `parameters`/`environment` never
  surface; the mark→capture join stays 1:1 and an unresolvable mark
  emits NULL capture fields with the sole report still attributing
  the source; a sealed capture's recorded tier passes verbatim to the
  sig_export boundary.
- `make check` — lint + format + mypy clean; pytest **9,677 passed /
  4 failed / 2 skipped** — the four are env-armed base-identical reds
  recorded on P35.32's ledger (`SIG_GCP_PROJECT` OP-07 unset locally;
  the P34.18 handle-list pair driven by the operator's local
  restricted map — `D-P35.3-3`'s recorded class), none touching this
  row's files.
- `SIG_REQUIRE_DB_TESTS=1 pytest tests/db/test_transparency_views.py`
  — 6/6 green including the whole-plan `sqitch deploy --verify` (the
  new change's verify DO-block proves the C-13 rule in-engine).

## Honest absences (typed, never fabricated)

- `staleness` — `not_evaluable` + undated counts (C-5; PKG-10 owns).
- `last_sig_records_change` — `first_release`/`not_published` (no
  previous release carries per-source slices; UX9-4/P36.68 names the
  refinement owner).
- `scheduler_drift` — plumbed as a recorded signal; no producer yet
  (the live comparison is the probe machinery's) — the class simply
  fires nothing until one lands.
- Per-source lane labels — the interim lane map derives `unknown`/
  `not_recorded` until row 313's lane/class fields land
  (`D-P35.31-1`).
- No live leg — output arrives with the next republish under its
  row's legs; nothing public changes at merge.
